name: StartIpuOutputTransfer
evidence: starts DMA channel 3 (from the IPU) with the DMA suspended while its control register is written

name: StartIpuInputTransfer
evidence: starts DMA channel 4 (to the IPU) the same way

name: SaveIpuDmaChannels
evidence: saves the state of the IPU's two DMA channels (SaveMpegDmaState calls it)

name: RestoreIpuDmaChannels
evidence: restores the state of the IPU's two DMA channels and restarts them (RestoreMpegDmaState calls it)

name: SyncIpu
evidence: waits while the IPU is busy (mode 0) or tells whether it is (mode 1)
